title: The inbox shows an open question's notes under it
intention: The operator inbox prints every note an open question carries under that question, oldest first, each with who wrote it and when.
why: db99e97f7b4f (built 2026-10-11) gives an open question a 'notes' list (cairn/tools/question/question.py note()) and renders it in cairn question show, but left cairn/tools/operator_inbox alone under RULE 1, so the QUESTIONS FOR OPERATOR section prints only id, ticket, question and born_of. Akien reads questions in the inbox; a note taken there to help him answer is invisible where he answers.
traces_to: Akien's review bandwidth (memory akiens-review-bandwidth-is-the-binding-constraint): what helps him answer must be where he answers.
how: cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py render, QUESTIONS FOR OPERATOR loop only: after the born_of line, for each entry of q.get('notes') or [] append '      note (<by>, <at>): <text>'. read_questions already returns the whole record, so no reader change.
falsifier: cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_the_inbox_shows_question_notes.py under PROVES {'abcad52a407e': {'1','2'}} on a scratch questions dir: (1) an open question with two notes renders both note lines, in order, under its question line; (2) an open question with no notes renders exactly as today. Hollow: today's render reds 1.
watchme: none, because the fault is measured at /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py and the proof's teeth are its falsifier
intent_berth: none, because this is a bug entering as a ticket (skills/intent/SKILL.md, the TICKET entry point), born from the measured fault at /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py

decisions.text: Notes print whole, never truncated; the inbox is where he decides. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py format_inbox, QUESTIONS FOR OPERATOR loop: after the born_of line, for n in q.get('notes') or []: lines.append(f"      note {n.get('at')} ({n.get('by')}): {n.get('text')}"). The shape matches `cairn question show` (question.py render, line 358) so one record reads one way in both places. read_questions already returns the whole record; no reader change; question.py is not touched (RULE 1). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

The proof is cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_the_inbox_shows_question_notes.py, PROVES {'abcad52a407e': {'1','2'}}, over a scratch questions dir handed to gather_all(questions_dir=...). Tooth 1: two notes print in order directly under their question (red before the build, measured 2026-10-11). Tooth 2: a no-note question renders contiguously into '\n\n  answer with:' (a guard, green before and after). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
